label: Local 404
summary: You are a henchperson for Doctor Malvora. The coffee is terrible, the hero is coming and the staff want a union.
title: Local 404
description: It is Tuesday at Doomspire Tower. Doctor Malvora is about to launch her tenth plan to take over the city, the heroic Captain Brightstar is on the way to stop her, and the henchpeople are holding their first union meeting in the break room. They want you to be their representative.

chapterOutlines.title: The Break Room
chapterOutlines.outline: Attend the union meeting and get elected, whether you like it or not.

chapterOutlines.title: Plan Ten
chapterOutlines.outline: Survive the launch of the doomsday device and the hero's arrival.

chapterOutlines.title: Negotiations
chapterOutlines.outline: Negotiate with a supervillain in the middle of a battle.

chapterOutlines.title: Collective Action
chapterOutlines.outline: Decide what the henchpeople of Doomspire really want.

scene.location: The break room on floor 13 of Doomspire Tower, Tuesday, 8:55 a.m.
scene.summary: The coffee machine is broken again. Forty henchpeople in matching purple jumpsuits are crammed in. Someone has made a banner: Local 404, Henchpeople United.

openThreads: Is Captain Brightstar really a hero?

npcs.name: Doctor Malvora
npcs.description: A brilliant supervillain with a cape, a laugh and a ten-step plan for everything except human resources.

npcs.name: Gary from Accounts
npcs.description: A henchperson from Accounts who has read every labor law ever written and keeps a laminated copy in his helmet.

npcs.name: Captain Brightstar
npcs.description: The city's most famous superhero, with perfect hair, a perfect smile and no idea that henchpeople have names.

relationships.label: Boss
relationships.status: Does not know who you are

relationships.label: Coworker
relationships.status: Thinks you are a natural leader

items.name: Henchperson's ray gun
items.description: Mostly makes a noise and a light. Occasionally does something worse.
